newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita plans another 100 bln yen write-off.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita plans another 100 bln yen write-off.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co plans to write off another 100 billion yen in bad debt at its troubled finance unit NL Finance, a company official said on Tuesday.
But the loss will not affect its business results, the official said.
"We will take measures such as realising special profits by sales of stocks so as not to affect the business results," Matsushita director Motoi Matsuda told a news conference.
Matsushita's unrealised profits on stock holdings amount to 1.5 trillion yen at present, down from 1.6 trillion yen at the end of September last year, Matsuda said.

The company earlier announced that it would post a special loss of 104 billion yen in its parent results in the current business year to March 31 as a result of a write-off of its 100 billion yen long-term loan to NL Finance.
But it said its parent results would not be affected by the special loss as it would be offset by special gains from stock sales.
